title: Jumbo's Vanilla
description: If you're looking for a modpack to chill and enjoy Minecraft solo, check this out.
body:
![camping in the forest](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b79fb15c24417deb30ad6bad65bf85c6fc953ec3.png)

# 🌿 Jumbo's Vanilla —  Vanilla + Experience

⚡ Optimized Fabric 1.20.1 modpack  
🧭 Enhanced exploration & progression  
🎮 Vanilla feeling, modern gameplay  
🚀 Ready to play — no setup needed


Perfect balance between performance and content.

### 🌍 World Generation
### 
-Terralith overworld generation

-Incendium Nether overhaul

-Nullscape End expansion

-Improved structures by YUNG's mods

### ⚔️ Progression & Survival
### 
-LevelZ progression system

-Progressive Bosses

-End Remastered progression

-Balanced backpack system

### 🎨 Visual Experience

Includes lightweight visual improvements:

-Complementary Reimagined Shader (Potato config)

-Vanilla‑friendly resource pack

-Dark Mode UI

### ⚡ Performance

Recommended specs:

-i3 / Ryzen 3 or better

-8 GB RAM

-4–6 GB RAM allocated to Minecraft

Shader optional and configurable.

### 📦 Installation
1. Install Fabric Loader (1.20.1)

2. Import the modpack using Modrinth App

3. Allocate 4–6GB RAM

4. Enable resource packs & shader

5. Create a new world and enjoy!

### Vanilla‑friendly resource pack from Vanilla Tweaks: https://vanillatweaks.net/
